stages.sub: How the Retail Prices Index differs from the CPI as a way of tracking prices.

steps.q: CPI leaves out mortgage interest and council tax. Would an index that included them track exactly the same prices as CPI?

steps.wrong: Yes, it would end up identical to the CPI
steps.hint: Adding in housing costs that CPI excludes changes what is being measured.
